title: Engraved orbit
description: Fine silver engravings wrap a polished navy sphere, revealing its curvature as the object rotates in a pale studio.
useCase: Procedural material previews, interactive product studies and sculptural identity assets.
interaction: Drag or use arrow keys to rotate; adjust engraving pitch and toggle automatic rotation.
reducedMotion: Automatic rotation stops; manual rotation and pitch changes redraw immediately. Host pause stops the clock and cancels an unfinished drag.
limitations: An analytic shader sphere with procedural engraved latitude lines and approximate studio lighting; no mesh model, environment map or exported 3D asset. Requires WebGL 1.
look: Pale powder-blue studio with a glossy navy sphere wrapped in fine pale-silver contour lines, a soft floor shadow, and minimal navy controls.
motion: The engraved sphere spins continuously about its vertical axis at 0.15 rad/s; dragging or arrow keys stop the spin and turn or tilt it directly, and pitch changes line density.
adapt: Everything renders in the `FRAGMENT` shader: spin speed is `u_time*.15`, line count `(14.+u_ink*25.)`, and drag feeds `u_pointer` from `pointer`. Recolour `enamel` and `metal` for your material; keep `cancelDrag`, context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
